loadingNeed.basis: 2 truck loading bays for 1,457 m² of floor. The Parking By-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The count uses row 5.2.5: the by-law does not name data centres, but the City classes them as a Transportation and Storage use (RTS 19744), which row 5.2.5 lists. Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1).

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim). genLines: 3 generator sets of about 1 MW carry 2.9 MW; with spares, 4. Placed: 0 on the roof, 4 in the yard.
Each about 8.434 × 2.616 m, 3.706 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 3100 L. In the yard: 3 m from the property line and 1.5 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.
